name: llama.cpp ROCm on RX 9070 XT: Llama-2-7B Q4_0 FA-off tg128
methodology: COMMUNITY-SCOREBOARD (llama.cpp discussion #15021, maintainer-curated). llama-bench -m llama-2-7b.Q4_0.gguf -ngl 99 -fa 0. AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (16 GB / GDDR6 / 256 bit). Build commit 583cb83, reporter @Hadrianneue. Mean +/- std (±0.27). Single-GPU run per thread rules. Per-request batch-1, NOT aggregate.
notes: Maintainer-verified scoreboard row from #15021. Identical model/test/flags across all GPUs. tg128 = decode, pp512 = prompt processing. 640 GB/s GDDR6; sits between MI100 (110) and W7900 (121) on decode.
